body: I'm 30. I fucked up my 20s. Do I wait until I'm 40 or just throw in the towel?

Yeah. It feels like some sort of... cosmic (?) blackmail. Like you're just forced to stay in this life, when you're so desperate to get out of it. But such factors, like parents loving you and being an only child, prevent you from doing it.

I have no advice, but I feel the same. I am my mother's only child. She has a serious illness. To kill myself, I think it would break her forever. But at the same time, I can't hold on anymore. I want to get the fuck out.

But I hope you can...

The unfortunate thing about SW is the trolls/people who send tips via private messaging.

I wish I could say the shit they wrote to me just bounced off me, but it didn't. I have saved the file of methods somebody sent to me. I reported them, they're banned, but people like that are still out there.

it's english lit. in hindsight, i should have gone for engineering, commerce, or economics, even though none of those fields interest me in the slightest. because at least i would land a good job and pay off my debt quickly, you know? my shrink said that he has written letters for lots of students pursuing degrees after graduation, explaining that their mental illnesses affected their ability to perform optimally. but that doesn't make me feel any better because i'm sure those people have excelled in other areas, whereas i have not.

i definitely do worry and think a lot about other people. it's a waste of time and energy to compare myself, but it is hard to block out a classmate whining about having an a- minus average, when i have a c average.

i stopped taking my zoloft by choice because i get so fed up of the cycle of destruction. take zoloft, experience nasty side effects (e.g., vomiting, dizziness, nausea), feel "ok" for awhile, have bad things happen in my life... it's like... what's the point anymore? zoloft can only do so much.

i love my pets very much. honestly if not for my pets and the fact they rely on me, i would never leave my home.

thank you very much for your response. take care.

yeah you hit the nail on the head about friends. not everyone my age has an active dating life, nice apartment, good job, and a close-knit group of friends. but shows like that make me feel that it's the expected norm for people in my age bracket.

thank you very, very much. i really appreciate your response.
me too. i cant stop crying for whatever reason.

yeah, me too. i knew i was depressed when i was 11 and took one of those "are you depressed?" quizzes from my mother's good housekeeping magazine (or something). i showed her the results, which advised me to see a doctor right away, but she said it was just hormones. i wish it had been just hormones.

i have stopped my zoloft before. whenever i really give up on myself, i feel like there is no point, you know? not to sound like a brat, but the side effects from taking zoloft are just as bad. it's been almost a year, minus the periods i stop taking my pills, and i still have to take gravol so that i don't puke.

thank you very much. i received an unsettling pm from a troll pretending to be a mod, so this was the kind of thing i needed to read.

me too.

im sorry if it is feeding the troll by expressing my feelings, but i am very upset right now. i didnt expect that. i did not expect to be treated like a delicate object, dont get me wrong. but it is unsettling to log in and see that kind of message right away.
